states.changed: A reader meets a grid of nine legal texts on six questions, can switch it to the law in force and see the columns for the chip holder and for stated compute go empty, and can read how much of the 37.8 % kept share sits with holders named on a public list.

A reader meets a third section: a ladder that takes the three laws in force from a written sanction to an imposed penalty, can limit it to chip holders and model developers and see every charge leave it, and can open each of the 15 parties the records name.
